summary_notes: Outbound post-op follow-up after right-eye cataract surgery. Patient verified by DOB and authorized son Jules to discuss care. Drops reviewed: antibiotic tan cap and prednisolone white cap both four times daily, five minutes apart; son corrected chart from three to four times daily. Night shield used. Patient reported new floaters, flashes, and gray curtain in operated eye; nurse advised urgent same-hour evaluation, instructed son to go to Corrowind Eye Clinic urgent entrance on Westbrook Road, bring drops/discharge papers, avoid bending/lifting, and said on-call ophthalmologist Dr. Achebe-Lindqvist would be called. Secondary issue: duplicate $40 copay charge via ClearPay; nurse will route to billing.
notable_details: Surgery: cataract surgery on Tuesday, right eye.
Son Jules authorized to discuss care; permission documented.
Medication correction: prednisolone white cap changed from three times daily to four times daily; antibiotic tan cap four times daily; wait five minutes between drops.
New symptoms: floaters, flashes, and gray curtain/shadow from the right side in the operated eye.
Urgent plan: Corrowind Eye Clinic urgent entrance on Westbrook Road within the hour; bring drops and discharge papers; avoid bending/lifting; go to emergency department if unable to get there.
Billing issue: $40 copay paid at front desk Tuesday, then charged again yesterday via ClearPay; billing team to call.
Patient initially thought the new visual symptoms were part of healing.
